senses.gloss: f. (רָאָה), מ׳ (ה)עין, appearance, sight, semblance.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:3">Bekh. VII, 3</cite> <he>מפני מ׳ הע׳</he> because he is repulsive to look at.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26:7">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite> <he>אינו מוליך … מפני מ׳ הע׳</he> he does not take his children with him, because he is afraid of the evil eye.—Esp. <he>מפני מ׳</he> (<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<cite ref="P00001"><he>ע׳</he></cite> in order to avoid the semblance of wrong-doing, for appearance sake.

<cite ref="Beitzah 9a:6">Bets. 9ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל מקום שאסרו חכמים מפני מ׳ הע׳ אפי׳ וכ׳</he> wherever the scholars have forbidden a thing for appearance sake, it is forbidden even in strictest privacy, cmp. <cite ref="H00214"><he>חֶדֶר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 8:9:4">Y. Erub. VIII, end, 25ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:2:2">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ</cite>. <he>ולית לרבנן מפני מ׳ ע׳</he> do the Rabbis not care for appearance?; a. fr.
